title: pr-pane 0.3.3: name a configure command that works
summary: The headless /prs autoOpen hint names 'claude plugin configure pr-pane', which 2.1.303 rejects.
description: evolv-marketplace's v0.3.2 install test: 'claude plugin configure pr-pane' fails with 'No installed plugin has the id "pr-pane". Use its full id (name@marketplace)', and the command takes values only through --values-stdin. The working form is: echo '{"autoOpen":"true"}' | claude plugin configure pr-pane@evolv-marketplace --values-stdin. A plugin's $ exposes only its name and root, not the install id, so the hint cannot name the exact id.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every /prs autoOpen hint shows the --values-stdin form with a full name@marketplace id, the value matching the verb asked for (true for enable, false for disable)
The README gives the same working form
validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: AC1: live 'claude -p --plugin-dir plugin' on fix/pr-pane-0.3.3: the bare form shows {"autoOpen":"true|false"} and disable shows "false", each with 'claude plugin configure pr-pane@<marketplace> --values-stdin (pr-pane@evolv-marketplace for the evolv install)'. The tests assert the per-verb value. The form itself was proven working by evolv-marketplace's v0.3.2 install test.
AC2/AC3: README diff on this branch; 25/25 tests, validate --strict, tsc 0 errors.
